§6Bitumen§f

§aThick, heavy, and perfect for asphalt. Or crack it back into crude oil. Your call.§f

Bitumen is a viscous byproduct from processing §bHeavy Oil§f in the §bFractioning Tower§f. Every §e100mB§f of Heavy Oil yields §e30mB§f of Bitumen.

§6Main Uses§f:
§b• Asphalt§f: §e1,000mB§f Bitumen + §e2× Gravel§f + §e6× Sand§f → §e16× Asphalt blocks§f. Increases player speed by §e50%§f and has §e72.0§f blast resistance.
§b• Catalytic Cracking Tower§f: §e100mB§f Bitumen + §e200mB§f Steam → §e80mB§f Crude Oil + §e20mB§f Aromatic Hydrocarbons.
§b• Coker Unit§f: §e16,000mB§f → §e1× Petroleum Coke§f + §e1,600mB§f Coker Oil.
§b• Solidification§f: §e100mB§f → §e1× Oil Tar§f.

Other production routes: §bChemical Plant§f (Tar Sand + Oil Tar → §e1,000mB§f), §bIndustrial Liquefaction§f (Coal Tar/Oil Tar/Crack Oil Tar).

§ePS:§f Direct coking is wasteful at §e16,000mB§f per coke. Fraction it down first, then process the lighter outputs.
